mapper.sql: select task_id, phone, duration_seconds, threads_per_task, status, running_phone, start_time, plan_end_time, actual_end_time, success_count, fail_count, owner_id, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from tool_stress_task
mapper.select: select task_id, phone, duration_seconds, threads_per_task, status, running_phone, start_time, plan_end_time, actual_end_time, success_count, fail_count, snapshot_json, owner_id, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from tool_stress_task where task_id = #{taskId}
mapper.insert: insert into tool_stress_task ( phone, duration_seconds, threads_per_task, status, running_phone, start_time, plan_end_time, success_count, fail_count, snapshot_json, owner_id, create_by, create_time ) values ( #{phone}, #{durationSeconds}, #{threadsPerTask}, #{status}, #{runningPhone}, #{startTime}, #{planEndTime}, #{successCount}, #{failCount}, #{snapshotJson}, #{ownerId}, #{createBy}, sysdate() )
mapper.update: update tool_stress_task set status = #{status}, actual_end_time = #{actualEndTime}, running_phone = null, update_time = sysdate() where task_id = #{taskId} and status = 'RUNNING'
update tool_stress_task set success_count = success_count + #{successCount}, fail_count = fail_count + #{failCount}, update_time = sysdate() where task_id = #{taskId}
update tool_stress_task set status = 'INTERRUPTED', actual_end_time = #{now}, running_phone = null, update_time = sysdate() where status = 'RUNNING'
mapper.delete: delete from tool_stress_task where task_id = #{taskId} and status != 'RUNNING'
